guard.note: init: the title screen is shown (first time = the warm-up starts)
handleLogin: PacketUtils.ensureRunningOnSameThread first, then the client level is created (the join)
disconnect(Screen, boolean): leaving the world (disconnect() and disconnect(Screen) call it)
clearClientLevel: the client level is dropped when the server sends the client back to configuration

client_class_warmup.conversion: @Inject RETURN of TitleScreen.init (warm-up thread once per launch + JFR class-define recorder), @Inject RETURN of ClientPacketListener.handleLogin (join: 3-minute recorded window, warm-up limit join + 10 s), @Inject HEAD of Minecraft.disconnect(Screen, boolean) and of Minecraft.clearClientLevel(Screen) (leave: window closes, warm-up stops); helpers bons.furious.patch.client_class_warmup.ClassWarmup (list file, fingerprint, warm-up: Class.forName(name, false, gameLoader) + getDeclaredConstructors) and ClassDefineRecorder (jdk.jfr RecordingStream, jdk.ClassDefine only); require = 0
client_class_warmup.license: Minecraft (Mojang) and NeoForge: no code of either is carried; the helpers are our own and only load and link classes the game itself defined before (JDK Flight Recorder for the list)
